claimedSlice: opencv2/cudaobjdetect.hpp parser-backed CUDA object-detection public declarations plus the pinned module CMake build/dependency contract
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact CudaObjDetect wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The cudaobjdetect module is disabled unless the OpenCV build enables CUDA or CUDA stubs and is unavailable on iOS; real object detection depends on an external CUDA toolkit/runtime.

The module requires opencv_objdetect, opencv_xobjdetect, opencv_cudaarithm, and opencv_cudawarping plus GpuMat/Stream data, asynchronous execution policy, detector model transport, and output ownership outside this package; no CUDA object-detection wrapper/runtime is bundled.

declarations.reason: Enum and class declarations are retained as parser metadata; callable evidence is classified independently.

declarations.identity: cv.cuda.HOG.create(Size win_size=Size(64, 128);Size block_size=Size(16, 16);Size block_stride=Size(8, 8);Size cell_size=Size(8, 8);int nbins=9)->Ptr<HOG>
declarations.reason: The CUDA object-detection surface in cv::cuda has no native CudaObjDetect wrapper entrypoint or managed public owner in the current package; OpenCV disables the module on iOS and unless CUDA or CUDA stubs are enabled, while real HOG/cascade execution requires an external CUDA toolkit/runtime and the upstream objdetect/xobjdetect/cudaarithm/cudawarping dependency chain. GpuMat/Stream ownership, asynchronous execution, detector model transport, and output rectangle/confidence ownership remain outside the current ABI/API and deterministic smoke contract.
